title: Tidewater Utilities Announces Second Customer Bill Credit Using PFAS Litigation Proceeds

(Tidewater), a water service provider and wholly owned subsidiary of Middlesex Water Company, today announced that it will refund approximately $0.5 million to customers through a bill credit. The refund is funded by proceeds received from litigation addressing per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS).
